Overview

Eisenstadt is a city in Burgenland with a population of 14,476. The capital of Burgenland, home to the magnificent Esterházy Palace, a Haydn museum, and surrounded by the region’s famous wine-growing areas. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
